name: DRAM 5112
title: Arts Leadership and Cultural Management Advanced Topic Research
description: Coursework consists of a single major research project, or series of smaller projects, in preparation for the student's M.F.A project. The Advanced Topic Research project, or projects, may or may not be directly related to the candidate’s M.F.A Project, but must serve in some direct way to help prepare the students for the M.F.A Project.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
